key_insight: OrbitTAMP turns natural-language spacecraft rendezvous commands into physically valid plans by grounding LLM reasoning in reusable behaviors, planning modules, and trajectory optimization.
engineering_relevance: It offers a scalable, auditable way to reduce manual expert translation from intent to safe spacecraft RPO maneuvers.
method: LLM converts a command into a partial mission specification.
Planners fill in missing decisions using admissible behavior graphs and domain-specific constraints.
Trajectory optimization produces a dynamically feasible final trajectory.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 98% exact recovery of partial mission specifications across all evaluated splits with frontier LLMs, and a 9B model improves from 75% to 88% with verifier-guided revision.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the behavior graph, planning modules, and verifier; weak domain modeling could still yield plausible but operationally suboptimal plans.
paper_title: OrbitTAMP: Grounding Language Models for Task and Motion Planning in Spacecraft Rendezvous
